text:
josh (sec): Heads-up — proposing a KMS key policy change for the eu-west-1 dedicated fleet keystore. New GPU nodes are failing to decrypt bootstrap secrets during provisioning, causing timeouts. Need a quick decision on cross-account decrypt for dedicated-deploy.

marie (infra): saw the provisioning errors this morning. Is it definitely a key-policy issue or could private endpoint routing/firewall be dropping traffic? :thinking_face:

josh (sec): It's a mix. Current key policy only allows principals from the control account. Dedicated fleet bootstrappers run from a separate account (redwood-dedicated-eu). We need to add the dedicated-deploy role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dedicated-deploy so nodes can decrypt their bootstrap data. Proposed snippet (minimal):
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dedicated-deploy"},
    "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}
```

lee (ops): adding that principal will create cross-account decrypt events in CloudTrail — audit volume will spike. We should pre-approve with compliance and add an alert for anomalous decrypt rates. Also the infra team found a privateLink egress rule blocking ephemeral ports used by the bootstrap flow (tcp 1024-1030) — that also explains some timeouts.

sre-oncall: cluster health note: node-provision failures line up with AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt and a simultaneous control-plane timeout to the private endpoint. We pushed a temporary fallback to use software-encrypted assets (local decrypt at higher CPU cost) so urgent traffic can proceed.

marie (infra): request: do a scoped policy rather than Resource: '*' — limit to the dedicated keystore alias/ARN and add SourceVpce or CallerAccount conditions so we don't open keys broadly.

josh (sec): agreed. new draft uses the key ARN and conditions. Example condition piece (draft):
```json
"Condition":{
  "StringEquals":{
    "kms:CallerAccount":"123456789012",
    "aws:SourceVpce":"vpce-0abc1234def"
  }
}
```
This keeps decrypts locked to requests coming through our vpce and the dedicated account.

auditor-bot: Compliance checklist entry created: COMPL-2026-EU-KMS. Please ensure key rotation remains on and that CloudTrail + S3 retention for decrypt events is set to 13 months. Add reviewers from privacy and infra. :white_check_mark:

marie (infra): timeline? We should do this in the low-provisioning window (Sunday 02:00 UTC) and run a 5-node canary first.

josh (sec): plan: open PR to infra repo with policy change + CloudTrail filter + Grafana panel for kms:Decrypt counts. Manual approver: sec-lead. I'll also attach the firewall ticket for temporary VPC endpoint relax if needed.

deploy-bot: PR created -> https://git.redwood/internal/infra/PR/2456 (policy + cloudtrail lambda + grafana dashboard).

lee (ops): cost note for finance: extra decrypt calls are cheap per-op, but CloudTrail ingestion + S3 storage is the main delta. Rough estimate: +$120/month if we keep 30-day higher-volume retention and the new alert logs. Filing FIN-ops-2026 for review.

sre-oncall: once PR is approved I'll kick the canary in eu-west-1 (5 nodes). If we still see privateLink drops we'll ask netsec to temporarily open the endpoint port range for the canary only.

josh (sec): ack. I'll get compliance sign-off and paste the final key policy here before apply. Ping me if you see further KMS denies or new provisioning errors. :eyes:
